title: Z
text: 对复阻抗建模；按 {Complex impedance (Ohm)} 指定阻抗值；{Impedance type} 指定频率相关性 Frequency、{Frequency} 指定频率相关阻抗的频率值 1e9，按实例取值。

params.name: Impedance type
params.values: 频率相关性 Frequency independent (default) | Frequency dependent

params.name: Complex impedance (Ohm)
params.values: 阻抗值 50 (default) | scalar complex number | vector of complex numbers

params.name: Frequency
params.values: 频率相关阻抗的频率值 1e9 (default) | nonnegative scalar number | nonnegative vector numbers
